description: A Minecraft mod that transforms the third-person camera into a true RPG-style experience. Inspired by classic MMORPGs like World of Warcraft, RPG Camera introduces smooth third-person controls, dynamic camera behavior, and a more immersive player perspective - perfect for role-playing and MMO-style gameplay in Minecraft. ⚔️🧙

mods.name: RPG Camera and Controls
mods.description: Adds an RPG-style third-person camera to Minecraft.
